title: Announce store tests leak temp dirs on assertion failure
description: announce_store.rs tests call std::fs::remove_dir_all only on the success path; any assert failure leaves lichen-node-announce-* dirs (0600 sealed records derived from test key material) in std::env::temp_dir(). Disk litter only — pid+counter names are collision-free. Fix: drop-guard struct so cleanup runs on unwind. Mirrors existing gap in gateway and lichen-hal tests. Found by robustness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-12zy.
